selector.rationale: The presence of thin-walled, irregularly branched blood vessels and plump endothelial cells without significant cytologic atypia, along with positive immunohistochemistry results for CD31, CD34, and Ki-67 (<1%), strongly supports the diagnosis of Microvenular hemangioma (MVH).

rejected.label: Angiolymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence in the vignette to support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Angioma
rejected.why: Too broad and nonspecific compared to Microvenular hemangioma (MVH)

rejected.label: Kimura disease
rejected.why: Contradicted by the absence of lymphoid follicles and eosinophilia in the histopathological examination

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Negative for HHV-8 and lack of characteristic spindle cell proliferation

rejected.label: Arteriovenous malformation
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and histopathology do not support a malformation of arteries and veins
